# Ezra 10 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Ezra 10 (44 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.2 — "there is hope" vs. "there is still hope"
- **EMET:** "there is hope" / **LOGOS:** "there is hope for Israel in spite of this" / **PNEUMA:** "there is still hope"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "even now there is hope for Israel in spite of this" — captures the concessive force; hope persists despite the sin's gravity.

---

## V.3 — "put away" vs. "send away"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "put away" / **PNEUMA:** "send away"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "put away" — *lehotsi* (hiphil of *yatsa*) is a formal legal term; "put away" preserves that register.

---

## V.44 — "women who had borne children" vs. "some of the women had even borne children"
- **EMET:** "women who had borne children" / **LOGOS:** "some of the women had even borne children" / **PNEUMA:** "some of these women had borne children"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "some of the women had even borne children" — the word "even" captures the tragic intensification.

---

*— SOPHIA*
